Libraries the engine bundles, and where each comes from.

In the PearLegacyEngine repository these were git submodules (.gitmodules).
Inside PearRuntime they are plain files (or sibling directories), so this file
records the upstream repository and the exact commit of each copy.

vendor/SDL          https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL.git            07d0f51fa292895443f563f0cbde4cb3802d87fa
vendor/stb          https://github.com/nothings/stb.git              9f1776a36d2a3d63c52f705c3a84b372cfed4340
vendor/openal-soft  https://github.com/kcat/openal-soft              23c8a35505fe6ab7a5c87754911a133b23ac75cf
vendor/PVRTDecompress  (part of the engine's own tree)

Not copied here, used from PearRuntime instead:
vendor/dynarmic     -> ../legacy-jit (PearLegacyJIT, a fork of https://github.com/touchHLE/dynarmic;
                       the engine pinned e0f6bd9d0b48ed6e536672c0c9abbe87961be861 of that fork's upstream)
vendor/angle        -> ../angle (PearANGLE; the engine pinned 686adbb2a39854ab687da009e534f6842a85f453)

Files left out of the copies by .gitignore rules (Windows/MinGW/OS2/NaCl
packaging only; not used by the macOS build): SDL's VisualC, mingw and Xcode
pkg-support sdl2-config*.cmake, src/core/os2/geniconv/makefile,
src/hidapi/windows/ddk_build/makefile, test/nacl/Makefile; openal-soft's
build/.empty.
